# Section backgrounds & floral ornaments — change report

**Assets:** 20 new original pixel-art scenes generated by `tools/build-art.mjs` (`npm run art`), each with animated layers
(water, waterfalls, sway, bobbing lotuses/boats, fireflies, sparkles, falling petals, lamp flames, hens, twinkling lights),
plus 8 animated 4-frame ornament sheets in `public/art/ui/orn-*.png`. Nothing is traced or copied from the references;
each scene re-composes their layout, palette and mood in pixel art.

| Language | Scenes (reference) |
| --- | --- |
| Tamil | `ta-lotus-dusk` (1), `ta-swan-pavilion` (2), `ta-lamp-pond` (3), `ta-hill-lights` (4), `ta-temple-petals` (5) + existing `ta-sunrise`, `ta-meadow` |
| Malayalam | `ml-lagoon-falls` (6), `ml-jungle-falls` (7), `ml-backwater-mist` (8), `ml-rice-terraces` (9), `ml-tharavad` (10) + `ml-hills`, `ml-banana` |
| Kannada | `kn-hoysala` (11), `kn-bougainvillea` (12), `kn-palm-coast` (13), `kn-green-hills` (14), `kn-misty-karst` (15) + `kn-sunset` |
| Telugu | `te-tea-estate` (16), `te-moon-jungle` (17), `te-palm-pond` (18), `te-thatch-hut` (19), `te-marigold-fields` (derived from 16–19; only 19 images were uploaded) + `te-mango` |

**System:** `public/js/backgrounds.js` is the single config: per language, the scene collection and a section → scene map
(home, vocabulary, dictionary, daily-topic, grammar, reading, videos, collections, notes, statistics, profile, settings, study,
learn, onboarding, admin). `scene.js` resolves the scene from the active language + current section; switching language
re-renders with that language's collection. Each scene carries a readability veil in `scenes.json`.

**Ornaments (CSS, `app.css`):** every button (both corners), every window frame (corners, title bar, title icon) and every
word card carries animated flowers: Tamil lotus + hibiscus, Malayalam blue lotus + coconut, Kannada yellow + orange
hibiscus, Telugu marigold + banana. Scenes add them too (Kannada hibiscus bushes, palms, bananas; Telugu marigolds and
bananas; Malayalam coconut palms and blue lotuses; Tamil lotuses and hibiscus). Animations stop for reduced motion / motion off.

**Verified:** real-browser run across 4 languages × 8 sections (correct scene and ornament set each time, no page errors),
mobile 390 px without horizontal overflow, `npm test` 57/57, static checks pass. Preview: `docs-section-backgrounds.png`.
